Labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Hub Pipeline Throttler

history.created_by: LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/uug-ai/hub-pipeline-throttler org.opencontainers.image.title=Hub Pipeline Throttler org.opencontainers.image.description=Suppresses stale media events before notification processing org.opencontainers.image.authors=UUG.AI
RUN |1 project=hub-pipeline-throttler /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache && apk add ca-certificates curl libstdc++ libc6-compat --no-cache && rm -rf /var/cache/apk/* # buildkit
RUN |1 project=hub-pipeline-throttler /bin/sh -c apk add libcap && setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /home/${project}/main # buildkit

Vulnerabilities.Description:
The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unsafe by design, has numerous known security issues, is not maintained, and should not be used.

If you are required to interoperate with OpenPGP systems and need a maintained package, consider github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/openpgp which is a maintained fork that aims to be a drop-in replacement for this package.
